text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right theeeere―! You're just 
barely in time for the start of school! 
Being tardy is the predecessor to 
delinquency! Do take care!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Jeeez. You can't be in a huff like that 
every day, you know! Look, Prez, your skin 
is rough.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Eh!? Rough skin!?!? Th, that can't be…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Neglecting one's health is the predecessor 
to delinquency! At this rate, am I going 
to become a delinquent…!?

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Seriously? Then, that makes me perfect, 
don't you think! I always take great care 
of my skin♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's this!? So, that means that, the 
delinquent… is……me!?

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Uuumm… I don't totally get what you're 
saying, but I'm sure it's fine! Don't 
worry about it!

Sakura Bakushin O went through a crisis 
due to her rough skin…
